query: UPDATE status_stats SET reblogs_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statuses WHERE reblog_of_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL), untrusted_reblogs_count = CASE WHEN untrusted_reblogs_count IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE LEAST(GREATEST(untrusted_reblogs_count + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statuses WHERE reblog_of_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL) - reblogs_count, 0), 100000000) END, updated_at = now() WHERE status_id = $1
